```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN num.Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) / 
  NULLIF(COUNT(den.Id), 0) AS accepted_rate
FROM main.posts den
LEFT JOIN main.posts num 
  ON den.AcceptedAnswerId = num.Id 
  AND num.PostTypeId = 2
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', num.CreaionDate) = '2013-12-01'
WHERE den.PostTypeId = 1
  AND den.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', den.CreaionDate) = '2013-12-01'
```
